scene.heading: DMART SELLS ₹100 OF GOODS. HOW MUCH DOES IT KEEP?
scene.note: BEFORE INCOME TAX · THE STORES BUSINESS · OUR ARITHMETIC FROM DMART'S RESULTS

say: Out of every hundred rupees D Mart sells, how much does it keep? Not twenty rupees. Not ten. Less than six, and that is before income tax. In the same three months last year, it kept six rupees and eighteen paise. This time, five rupees and sixty two. Fifty six paise went missing. That sounds like nothing. But it is almost a tenth of everything D Mart had left. So who took it?
